column1: Silly Squirrels
Seven silly squirrels ran through the park,
One lost his hat and it got dark.
Sister called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
No more squirrels running after bread!
Six silly squirrels climbed up the tree,
One dropped her nut and scraped her knee.
Brother called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
No more squirrels chasing after me!
Five silly squirrels danced in the rain,
One slipped down and twisted his chain.
Mama called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
No more squirrels playing in the lane!
Four silly squirrels rolled down the hill,
One bumped her nose and sat quite still.
Papa called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
No more squirrels tumbling with such skill!
Three silly squirrels sang loud and clear,
One lost his voice and shed a tear.
Sister called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
No more squirrels singing here!
Two silly squirrels jumped on the bed,
One fell down and hurt her head.
Brother called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
No more squirrels bouncing instead!
One silly squirrel sat all alone,
He found his nut and made it his own.
Mama called the Keeper and the Keeper said,
Put those squirrels back at home!
